entities.name: Query FabZ
observations: 152 aa bacterial protein; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt FabZ Q9CJK9 from Pasteurella multocida.
Predicted molecular mass is 17.29 kDa and theoretical pI is 6.31.
Contains FabA-like domain PF07977.20 spanning residues 20–144; additional ApeP-like and ApeI-like domain matches.
Likely catalyzes dehydration of beta-hydroxyacyl-acyl carrier proteins in fatty-acid synthesis.

entities.name: FabZ
observations: Reviewed UniProt annotations describe 3-hydroxyacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] dehydratase activity.
Catalyzes dehydration of short-chain beta-hydroxyacyl-ACPs and long-chain saturated and unsaturated beta-hydroxyacyl-ACPs.
Participates in fatty acid biosynthetic process and lipid A biosynthetic process.

entities.name: Fatty acid biosynthesis
observations: FabZ functions in bacterial fatty acid biosynthesis by converting beta-hydroxyacyl-ACP intermediates to enoyl-ACP intermediates.

entities.name: Lipid A biosynthesis
observations: FabZ is annotated as participating in lipid A biosynthesis in Gram-negative bacteria.
